newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-VOLGOGRAD MOVE TOP OF RUSSIAN LEAGUE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VOLGOGRAD MOVE TOP OF RUSSIAN LEAGUE.

text.p: Rotor Volgograd, third last season, moved top of the Russian league on Saturday with a 2-0 home win over Lokomotiv Nizhny Novgorod.
Rotor have 20 points from nine games, one more than Dynamo Moscow who beat Tyumen 2-0 at home.
Rostselmash Rostov, who had shared first place before Saturday, were held 1-1 by Shinnik in Yaroslavl and slipped to fourth.
Champions Spartak Moscow moved up to third with a 2-0 win over Krylya Sovietov Samara in Moscow. Sergei Gorlukovich and Maxim Buznikin scored their first goals of the season for the Muscovites.
Last year's runners-up Alania Vladikavkaz recorded their second straight victory after a shaky start to the season with a 2-0 win over Fakel Voronezh. They jumped to eighth.
